title: Engine result
description: [PROPOSED] Structured result returned by every engine after a PREVIEW or APPLY. Built from the current SISQUAL_JOB_RESULT_V1 summary (jobId, actionCode, succeeded, exitCode, target and error counts) and from the per-object rows the current engines write with Add-Result (Timestamp, InstanceCode, OperationType, Object, Status, Details). It never contains secrets: every free-text field is written by the engine after redaction.

operationId.description: Id of the operation created by the API (replaces jobId).

engineCode.description: Same codes as the current ops.Engine.EngineCode (for example IIS_RECONCILE), at most 60 characters.

engineVersion.description: Version of the local engine module that ran.

planFingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the normalised plan. APPLY must carry the fingerprint of the PREVIEW the operator confirmed (R-032).

errorMessage.description: Empty when succeeded. Never contains secrets, connection strings or stack traces with parameters.

backup.description: Present when an APPLY created a backup (R-033). Metadata only.

results.description: One row per object handled, in execution order.

instanceCode.description: Empty string for machine-wide rows (for example PREREQUISITE).

operationType.description: Engine specific (IIS_RECONCILE uses PREREQUISITE, DIRECTORY, ACL, APP_POOL, SITE, APPLICATION, APPLICATION_AUTO_START, AUTO_START_PROVIDER, BINDING, SSL_FLAGS, CERTIFICATE, POLICY, IIS_SETTING, START_POOL, START_SITE, START).

status.description: [PENDING] closed list. Statuses seen in IIS_RECONCILE v16.3: MATCHED, WOULD_CREATE, WOULD_UPDATE, WOULD_INSTALL, WOULD_CONVERT, WOULD_CONFIGURE, CREATED, UPDATED, CONVERTED, INSTALLED, MANAGED, WARNING, UNKNOWN_FEATURE, MISSING_MANUAL_ACTION, MISSING_REQUIRED_PATH, MISSING_APPLICATION, SKIPPED_BY_SQL, SKIPPED_BY_POLICY, SKIPPED_EXISTING_SITE, Started, Stopped. This draft accepts the shape only; the closed enum is set in the Phase 3 engine contract.

details.description: Redacted free text. Must never carry a password, token, private key or connection string.

x-validationRules: [PROPOSED] summary.targetCount = succeededTargets + failedTargets. succeeded is true only when failedTargets = 0 and errorCount = 0.
[PROPOSED] mode PREVIEW never carries a backup with created = true and never has statuses of an executed change (CREATED, UPDATED, CONVERTED, INSTALLED).
[PROPOSED] A secret-safety test per engine feeds a known marker value as a credential and asserts the marker is absent from this document, the logs and the transcripts.
[PENDING] Whether results are streamed (events) or returned whole at the end; the API skeleton assumes whole at the end plus progress events.
